generationBriefs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: Original square product photograph for an internal luxury gift-support storefront design study, 1024 by 1024 or higher, single image.
Primary request: A full, abundant boutique florist bouquet of deep ruby, cherry red and burgundy roses, some rich dark green leaves, gently wrapped in unbranded ivory paper and tied with a simple cream fabric ribbon. The entire bouquet is visible with at least 10% breathing room from every image edge. Place it on a warm milk-white plaster tabletop against a warm milk-white plaster studio backdrop. The wrapping should be restrained and beautifully folded; the red petals have convincing natural irregularity, soft curls and deep layered detail. Real photographic materials and plausible physical contact shadows.
Style/medium: High-end, photorealistic florist product photography; understated editorial taste, authentic flower textures, no illustration, no 3D-render look.
Composition/framing: Square, eye-level to slightly elevated three-quarter view, bouquet centered, product occupies approximately 70–78% of frame, coherent neutral negative space, no cropped petals or paper.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural side window light, warm neutral white balance, subtle physical shadows, no dramatic black background.
Constraints: No humans, no hands, no text, no lettering, no brand, no logo, no watermark, no extra props.
generationBriefs.framingEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original bouquet product photograph only to widen the camera framing / zoom out. Preserve the same ruby rose bouquet, same arrangement, same ivory paper and ribbon, same warm plaster background, realistic texture and soft window lighting. Show the complete object with a clearly visible 12% empty background margin on the left and right, and at least 10% margin above and below; all paper edges and ribbon tails must sit safely inside those margins. The current bouquet is too large in the frame, so make it about 75% of the image width. Keep square 1:1, minimum 1024×1024. No text, logos, extra props or people.
generationBriefs.visualInspection: Accepted: realistic ruby roses, dark foliage, ivory paper and ribbon, warm plaster background, physically plausible shadows, entire object safely framed with >=10% outer margin, no text/logo.
